decisions.name: Contacts Source Strategy
decisions.currentEvidence: No authoritative Contact source found after auditing 10 workbooks; no Contact records may be inferred or invented.

options.name: NEW SYSTEM ONLY
options.decision: Migrate Customers but create Contacts only in ABP from Go-Live.
options.businessImpact: No historical contacts; users build a clean governed directory during normal work.
options.cutoverImpact: Removes Contact migration from cutover and avoids an unbounded source dependency.
options.dataImpact: Zero migrated Contact rows; all new records have ABP lineage, authorization and audit.
options.risk: Initial Customer records may lack named contact channels until users add them.

options.name: MIGRATION LATER
options.decision: Go live without historical Contacts and keep a governed migration pending until an approved source is supplied.
options.businessImpact: Allows later recovery of trusted history without blocking the core launch.
options.cutoverImpact: No Contact load at initial cutover; a later controlled import/reconciliation is required.
options.dataImpact: Future source must include customer linkage, channel syntax, source keys, hashes and DQ evidence.
options.risk: Long-lived pending migration can create duplicate Contacts if deduplication and ownership are not governed.

decisions.optionC: NOT AVAILABLE: repository evidence identifies no real authoritative alternative.
decisions.recommendation: OPTION A — NEW SYSTEM ONLY. It is the safest initial V1 basis because no authoritative source exists; retain a separately approved future migration only as a governed change if a real source appears.

decisions.name: DR Malware-Scanning Decision
decisions.problem: Equivalent support for the Primary malware-scanning capability is not confirmed in UAE Central.

options.decision: Keep UAE Central and deploy an approved alternative failure-closed malware scanner behind private quarantine.
options.security: Acceptable only with equivalent verdict, audit, alerting, quarantine and failure-closed behavior.
options.costComplexity: Medium to high; adds scanner compute, signatures/updates, scaling, monitoring and operational ownership.
options.rtoRpo: Preserves UAE Central proximity but scanner capacity/startup must be included in DR RTO testing; database RPO design unchanged.
options.architectureImpact: Blob quarantine -> private scanner -> clean promotion; unsafe/unavailable scanner blocks release.
options.iacImpact: Add scanner workload, private endpoints/identity, queues/events, alerting and failure policies.
options.operationalImpact: Patch/signature management, capacity tests and incident runbook required.
options.goLiveImpact: RG-09 stays open until equivalence and a formal DR restore/scanning test pass.

options.decision: Select another Azure DR region with confirmed malware-scanning and required service parity.
options.security: Strongest managed-control parity if support is verified before selection.
options.costComplexity: Medium; regional architecture, egress, data residency and service availability must be reassessed.
options.rtoRpo: May increase latency or replication distance; RTO/RPO require measured validation.
options.architectureImpact: Region pair, networking, replication, Front Door routing and storage design change.
options.iacImpact: Parameterize/validate the replacement region and all dependent resources/policies.
options.operationalImpact: New regional failover, access and support runbooks; residency approval may be required.
options.goLiveImpact: RG-09 remains open until the region decision, parity proof and DR drill complete.

options.decision: Accept a time-bounded formal security exception for UAE Central.
options.security: Residual malware risk accepted explicitly; requires compensating controls, named risk owner, expiry and remediation date.
options.costComplexity: Lowest immediate build effort but creates governance, audit and remediation debt.
options.rtoRpo: Minimal immediate topology change; security capability is degraded during DR.
options.architectureImpact: No parity fix; compensating quarantine/manual controls must be documented.
options.iacImpact: Exception metadata and compensating controls only; no equivalent managed scanning.
options.operationalImpact: Manual review/escalation burden and strict exception expiry tracking.
options.goLiveImpact: Cannot close RG-09 without explicit Security and Business risk acceptance; not recommended for convenience.

decisions.recommendation: OPTION A first, because it preserves the selected UAE Central DR topology. If equivalent failure-closed scanning cannot be proven within the release window, select OPTION B. Do not select OPTION C by default.
